'$'''tee >(while read -r n, do
 echo "Branch1: $n" 1>&2 &
done) >(while read -r n, do
 echo "Branch2: $n" 1>&2 &
done) (&)' (686 us, 0.01%)

echo "Level 4 done")" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 3 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 2 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" (&' (732 us, 0.01%)

'$'''eval "nested_func_$depth() {
 local my_depth=$depth
 { { { echo \"Depth: \$my_depth\" >&2, } 2>&1 | sed '''s/^/ /''' >&2, } & } &
 wait \$! 2>/dev/null || true
 generate_recursive_hell \$((depth + 1))
' (173 us, 0.01%)
